name: CaseFocusBorderColorState
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "focus-border-color-state" (interaction-states). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a resting BORDER (1px solid #d4d4d8) whose `:focus-visible` rule repaints ONLY `border-color` — the state plane carries the four side colours and no width of its own
